options.a: It isn't fully formed, or the shape is wrong
The surface looks wrong (streaks, marks, dull, patterns)
It's weak, cracks, or breaks
Marks, threads, or ooze near the gate or nozzle
Trouble getting the part out of the mold
Dimensions are off or drift shot-to-shot
Specks or color problems in the plastic
It didn't fill out — part is incomplete
Thin flakes of plastic at the edges or parting line
Dimples or depressions over thick areas, ribs, or bosses
Hollow pockets inside (found when you cut it open)

surface.q: What does the surface look like?

options.a: Silver or off-color streaks fanning from the gate
Brown or black scorched spots
A worm-like squiggle starting at the gate
A hazy, dull halo right around the gate
Ripples, rings, or halos tracking the flow
A visible line where two flow fronts met
Patchy shiny and dull areas
The surface peels off in flaky layers
Swirls or streaks of uneven color
Snaps or cracks under loads it should handle (brittle)
Cracks or white stress marks at ejection or later
It always breaks along a visible line
The surface peels apart in layers

gate.q: What's happening at the gate or nozzle?

options.a: Fine threads or strings trail when the mold opens
Melt oozes or drools from the nozzle between shots
A worm-like squiggle mark at the gate
A hazy, dull halo at the gate
Part hangs in the cavity or on the core; sprue stuck
Circles, gloss, or sink marks where the pins push
Cracks or stress-whitening at the pins on ejection
Sizes wander shot-to-shot with nothing changed
Consistent, but the wrong size
It twists, bows, or cups (warp)

material.q: What do you see in the plastic?

options.a: Dark flecks or specks scattered through the part
Solid granules or gels — unmelted pellets
Swirls or uneven color / poor mixing
Silver streaks (could be moisture)
The surface peels apart in layers
